style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the bars wear a golden satin ribbon, so the keys are golden satin with a rose-pink Enter (a treat of the same world; no red, no violet).

images.why: Look: 'bars standing against one scale'; Does: 'stands each up as a bar rising from one baseline'; Student controls: 'Bar drag: moves a bar along the shelf into order'. A bar is a measure drawn as a length, so one satin ribbon texture is reused for every bar in every phase (the lengths, weights and capacities are the heights, drawn in code).
images.prompt: A long straight length of pale golden-yellow satin ribbon with fine woven edges and a smooth, soft sheen that glows gently along its length, the same light buttery gold from end to end.
